additional_findings.root_cause: Training imputer/winsor/scaler used nanmean/nanquantile while retaining infinities. One infinity corrupted otherwise valid finite training statistics and could silently replace a finite mean with zero.
additional_findings.fix: Normalize all nonfinite training features to NaN before sequential fitting; preserve caller arrays. Frozen steps include fit_semantics_version=finite-only-v2 in their existing state hash. Existing serialized states are not rewritten.
evidence: 5 independent regressions failed before fix; 13 focused tests passed after
additional_findings.migration: New fitted states are separately identified. Refit affected training-only states and reevaluate downstream models in shadow before any approved production switch. No production model or fitted state overwritten.
